subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns. Amazon SES: 4,000 emails × US$0.16 per 1,000, + US$12 hosting. The US$69 license makes the first month US$81.64. Tax and backups are extra.
5,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns. Amazon SES: 20,000 emails × US$0.16 per 1,000, + US$12 hosting. The US$69 license makes the first month US$84.20. Tax and backups are extra.
10,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns. Amazon SES: 40,000 emails × US$0.16 per 1,000, + US$12 hosting. The US$69 license makes the first month US$87.40. Tax and backups are extra.
50,000 subscribers × 4 campaigns. Amazon SES: 200,000 emails × US$0.16 per 1,000, + US$12 hosting. The US$69 license makes the first month US$113. Tax and backups are extra.
